pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Lets you possess and control a creature, using its natural abilities.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() all three Paths at level 15.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: You can use the creature’s available attacks: for example, a ghast can shoot fireballs and a creeper can explode. To leave, activate the ability again or press G. Leaving with G transfers the creature’s health to you: it first restores your health, and the remainder becomes hunger. If the creature does not have enough health, it dies. This exit starts $(l:beginning/spirit_form)Spirit Form$(/l)’s cooldown.
